scope: Source-bound claim inventory of manually named Sprint4 theorems. This inventory neither replaces the imported Lean axiom audit nor treats bounded runtime comparisons as general proofs.

extraction.method: Anchored theorem/lemma declarations and an explicit namespace stack, preserving dotted declaration prefixes such as Expr.eval_congr and Evaluated.effect_cons. Every extracted theorem must have an explicit reviewed category/meaning; unknown names refuse generation.
extraction.generated_declarations: Automatically generated recursors, projections, constructor injectivity/no-confusion/equation theorems, instances and implementation auxiliaries are intentionally not individually enumerated here. The parent automatic imported environment/axiom audit covers them and is authoritative; this list must not be used as an axiom-audit whitelist.
extraction.anonymous_examples: Anonymous example declarations, proof fields in State/Fintype instances and #eval comparisons are not manually named theorem entries. Runtime checks are separate executed evidence.

assumptions.exact_arithmetic: Numeric values and balances use exact rational arithmetic. No machine overflow, rounding, gas or deployed arithmetic refinement is established.
assumptions.finite_universe: Execution quantifies over arbitrary finite Party/Asset/Domain carriers with decidable equality; no dynamic creation or infinite deployment universe is modeled.
assumptions.input_state: State already contains a proof that its input balance function is nonnegative.
assumptions.authenticated_context: InvocationContext is adapter-supplied trusted principal/domain data. Lean construction is not digital signature verification or real-world identity authentication.
assumptions.trusted_registry: Registry selection and interpretation are trusted configuration. Caller Request contains no template, guard, expression body or validity certificate.
assumptions.admin_configuration: Standalone AuthorityConfig is supplied independently to administrative functions. The integrated examples derive its operationDomain from the same registry used for execution; the abstract authority theorems alone do not prove arbitrary supplied configurations agree with any registry.
assumptions.capability_store: Use theorems establish live exact scoped entries in the supplied store. They do not prove provenance of an arbitrary initial store or consumable allowance accounting.
assumptions.environment: Environment values/timestamps and current time are adapter inputs. Read agreement proves dependence, not observation truth, freshness or price positivity unless an operation guard explicitly checks those.
assumptions.refusal_scope: Template reference/effect evaluation precedes guard, footprint and domain checks. Success theorems do not assert confidentiality of reads or behavior on refused paths; failure precedence is separately exercised by runtime comparisons.
assumptions.net_effects: Effects and supplies aggregate by addition. Checks observe actual net decreases and total changes, not intermediate execution order, temporary debits, gross flows or allowance consumption.
assumptions.expression_scope: Read-dependence theorems concern expression evaluation, including failure equality and inactive-branch syntactic footprints. They do not prove full operation noninterference; registry/capabilities and trusted actor inputs also matter.
assumptions.internal_checker: applyEvaluated is a lower-level checker over already evaluated data. Its standalone theorems do not establish registry lookup, checked argument ingress, actor binding or invoke authority; execute-level theorems add those premises.
assumptions.example_scope: Examples are concrete reference/development operations, not untouched holdouts, deployed ERC-20/ERC-4626 fidelity proofs, market-truth claims or general solvency proofs.
assumptions.nondelegating_admin: Administration is nondelegating and list IDs are permanent positions. Replay is permitted and no nonce or expiration semantics is claimed.

theorems.scoped_meaning: Execution succeeds iff lookup selects a template for the requested operation; claimed actor, domain and party arity match; raw arguments check to typed arguments; invoke authority holds; that template actually evaluates; all concrete checker conditions hold; capabilities are unchanged; and all output balances equal the exact aggregate update.
theorems.proof_scope: universally quantified as stated in the elaborated declaration
theorems.source_header:
theorem execute_ok_iff (registry : Registry Party Asset Domain)
    (store : CapabilityStore Party Asset Domain) (ctx : InvocationContext Party Domain)
    (env : Environment Asset Domain) (now : Nat) (request : Request Party Asset Domain)
    (state : State Party Asset Domain) (post : ExecutionResult Party Asset Domain) :
    execute registry store ctx env now request state = .ok post ↔
      ∃ template, registry request.operation = some template ∧
      (request.claimedActor = none ∨ request.claimedActor = some ctx.principal) ∧
      ctx.domain = template.domain ∧ request.parties.length = template.partyArity ∧
      ∃ args, Args.check template.signature request.arguments = .ok args ∧
      hasAuthority store request.capabilityIds ctx request.operation .invoke = true ∧
      ∃ e, template.evaluate ⟨state, env, ctx.principal, request.parties, args, now⟩ = .ok e ∧
      e.Valid store ctx request state ∧ post.capabilities = store ∧
      ∀ c, post.state.balance c = state.balance c + e.effect c

theorem execute_accounting_and_locality
    (h : execute registry store ctx env now request state = .ok post) :
    ∃ template, registry request.operation = some template ∧
      ∃ args, Args.check template.signature request.arguments = .ok args ∧
